budgetMaster.openaiKey.description: Your OpenAI API Key (starts with sk-...)

budgetMaster.anthropicKey.description: Your Anthropic API Key (starts with sk-ant-...)

budgetMaster.xaiKey.description: Your xAI (Grok) API Key for Grok models

budgetMaster.googleKey.description: Your Google AI (Gemini) API Key from Google AI Studio

budgetMaster.kimiKey.description: Your Kimi (Moonshot AI) API Key from platform.moonshot.ai

budgetMaster.defaultModel.description: Default model when opening chat. Use 'auto' (smart routing), 'cascade', 'architect-builder', or any model id. Auto = try cheap first, then escalate (your keys, Cursor-like).

budgetMaster.cascadeCheapModel.description: Cheap model first in Cascade mode

budgetMaster.cascadeExpensiveModel.description: Escalation model when Cascade judge fails

budgetMaster.contextCacheEnabled.description: Use context caching for large context

budgetMaster.contextCacheTokenThreshold.description: Min tokens to use context cache

budgetMaster.sessionBudgetCap.description: Session budget cap in USD (0 = no cap). When exceeded, warn or pause.

budgetMaster.sessionBudgetPause.description: When over session budget cap: true = block new requests, false = warn only

budgetMaster.promptCorrectionEnabled.description: Correct prompt spelling, tech terms, and grammar before sending (cheaper cost). Benchmark tier shown per response.

budgetMaster.grammarCheckUseLanguageTool.description: Use LanguageTool API for deep grammar check (rate limit: 20 req/min; enable for highly intelligent correction).

budgetMaster.vectorVaultEnabled.description: RAG: retrieve only relevant chunks from pinned context (saves input tokens). Requires OpenAI key for embeddings.

budgetMaster.vectorVaultMinContextTokens.description: Min pinned context tokens to use Vector Vault (RAG).

budgetMaster.contextSqueezerEnabled.description: Token Crusher: strip comments and collapse blank lines in context before sending (30–40% token reduction on code).

budgetMaster.contextSqueezerStripComment.description: Context Squeezer: remove line and block comments (//, #, /* */, etc.).

budgetMaster.contextSqueezerStripBlankLi.description: Context Squeezer: collapse 3+ blank lines to one.

budgetMaster.contextSqueezerMinChars.description: Min context length (chars) to run Context Squeezer; below this, context is sent as-is.

budgetMaster.speculativeDrafterEnabled.description: Use cheap model to draft and expensive model to verify. Saves tokens on success, but takes longer.

budgetMaster.semanticCacheEnabled.description: Deja Vu Protocol: cache replies by intent + context hash. Repeat questions (e.g. same file, same question) return instantly at $0 cost.

budgetMaster.tokenMappingSchema.description: Output as code then map to label (saves output tokens). Empty = full reply.

budgetMaster.tokenizerArbitrageNote.description: Show tokenizer note in cost estimate (estimates vary by model).

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run compile && npx vsce package
